entities.summary: Yvette Yaa Konadu Tetteh is a Ghanaian-British entrepreneur and CEO of Pure and Just Food, which operates the brand Yvaya Farm Dried Fruit. She is noted to be the first Ghanaian to swim the down the length of the Volta River in Ghana.
